Gandelun includes mandatory full-hand discard with Carol replacement, actual entry silence, 0/1 versus 2 hand threshold, private top view on either turn, creature/spell-only normal paid main-phase use, existing hand-only/deck-look locks, original Vision union permissions and no unintended attack-chance casting. Shared engine changes covered by related old conditional abilities/entry histories/GR/first-attack/colour ordering regressions and online tests. GR-specific conservation tested in actual advance format; encrypted service includes interactive mana payment and persisted public entry history.
validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: Initial focused fixture corrected absent GR array and original-format fixture to actual advance; unsupported test-only GroupMove replaced with native ExactMove; sealed creature has power zero; real Genmu blocker explicitly declined when isolating ignored attack triggers; multicolor fixture corrected from a mono-Light card to actual Fire/Nature vanilla; service uses raw server action ID and completes the real interactive mana-payment decision before asserting entry. These failures and logs retained; no earlier pending record is cleared.
